query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative IMDb sentiment?

per_column.name: overall_craft_verdict
per_column.rationale: A clean ordinal quality scale (masterpiece..unwatchable) with well-separated categories, but it is essentially a proxy for overall sentiment/label_pos itself. Grouping on it largely restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship.

per_column.name: script_writing_quality
per_column.rationale: A thematic dimension (writing craft) with interpretable, well-separated categories. It is a distinct aspect of a review that can be segmented and compared against sentiment to reveal which themes track positive vs negative labels.

per_column.name: plot_originality
per_column.rationale: Interpretable categories about narrative originality; a genuine review theme that can be cross-tabbed against sentiment. 'not_present' is frequent but categories remain meaningful for comparison.

per_column.name: acting_quality
per_column.rationale: A separable performance theme with clear categories; strong candidate for segmentation against sentiment to explore theme differences.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_response
per_column.rationale: Categories are interpretable but the valence axis (positive vs negative emotion) is nearly collinear with label_pos, so it mostly restates the focus rather than exposing an external theme.

per_column.name: rewatch_intent
per_column.rationale: Behavioral-intent dimension that correlates with but is not identical to sentiment; segmenting on it can reveal how engagement themes vary and is an informative external variable.

per_column.name: comparative_benchmark
per_column.rationale: Captures a distinct rhetorical theme (comparison to peers/classics) with interpretable categories. Heavily 'not_present' (189) reduces power, but the remaining categories still support meaningful comparison.

per_column.name: explicit_recommendation
per_column.rationale: A clean recommend/advise-against scale, but it is close to a direct expression of sentiment polarity and thus largely restates label_pos rather than a separate theme.

per_column.name: genre_expectation_met
per_column.rationale: An expectation-fulfillment theme distinct from raw sentiment; interpretable categories that can be segmented to explore how met/failed expectations relate to positive vs negative labels.

judge.rationale: The set is well-designed for exploratory analysis: all columns use interpretable, well-separated categorical scales rather than opaque scores, and several (script, plot, acting, genre expectations, comparisons, rewatch intent) capture distinct review THEMES that can be cross-tabbed against sentiment to answer the query. The main weakness is redundancy: overall_craft_verdict, reviewer_emotional_response, and explicit_recommendation are near-proxies for label_pos and mostly restate the focus, and some columns are dominated by 'not_present', limiting segmentation power. Still, a majority provide genuine external, associational thematic variables, supporting good but not maximal informativeness.
